name: Shadowburst
body:
School evocation [darkness, shadow]; Level death mage 8, sorcerer/wizard 8, witch 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Area 30-ft. burst
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create an explosion of vile shadow energy pulled from the maelstroms in the shadow plane. Creatures within the area take 1d8 damage per caster level (maximum 20d8) and are sickened for 2d6 rounds. Half of the damage is negative energy damage and half cold damage.

Undead creatures and creatures native to the shadow plane are immune to this spell, in fact undead are healed by the negative energy portion of the damage. A successful Fortitude save halves the damage and negates the sickened condition.
